title: knowledge/1: the front matter of a knowledge item
description: The YAML block at the top of a Markdown knowledge item (plan 27 section 3.5c). The reader (KnowledgeItemLoader) is the authority; a test keeps this file's keys equal to the reader's. A folder file _knowledge.yml has `knowledge: 1` and `defaults:` with the keys of $defs.defaults.

title.description: One line. Left out, the first `# ` heading of the text is the title.

role.description: Found by search (reference), always given where its scope applies (instruction), or an instruction marked as policy (guardrail). Required unless a _knowledge.yml above gives it.

owner.description: A group of the identity home; approves changes to the item.

kind.description: An item, or a verified query (KN21): questions, the pinned request that answers them and who verified it.

questions.description: A verified query: the questions it answers, as people ask them. They are what is embedded and found.

model.description: A verified query: the semantic model it is asked of.

request.description: A verified query: the pinned semantic request (the document `semantic query --request` takes), as a mapping or JSON text. The request is the truth.

semantic-sql.description: A verified query: the same query as semantic SQL, kept for reading. Translated into the request when there is no request; when both are given they must agree.

saved-query.description: A verified query: a saved query of the model's catalog, with the model version it was verified against after @ when pinned.

at.description: A date or a date and time.

model-version.description: The version of the model the query was verified against.

verified.description: A verified query: who verified it, when and against which version of the model.

about.description: What the item is about; any one entry puts it in scope. An entry names one subject and may narrow it.

for.description: Who the item is for: each key narrows; a key left out means all.
